name: CI with gz-physics

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y \
          cmake \
          git \
          libboost-all-dev \
          libeigen3-dev \
          libode-dev \
          libtinyxml-dev \
          liburdfdom-dev \
          libccd-dev \
          libfcl-dev \
          libsdformat-dev \
          libignition-math-dev \
          libignition-common-dev \
          libignition-fuel-tools-dev \
          libignition-gazebo-dev \
          libignition-rendering-dev \
          libignition-sensors-dev \
          libignition-tf-dev \
          libignition-utils-dev \
          libignition-transport-dev \
          libignition-physics-dev \
          libgz-physics-dev \
          libgz-sim-dev \
          libgz-rendering-dev \
          libgz-sensors-dev \
          libgz-tf-dev \
          libgz-utils-dev \
          libgz-transport-dev

    - name: Build and test
      run: |
        mkdir build && cd build
        cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
        make -j$(nproc)
        ctest --output-on-failure

        sudo apt-get install -y \
          cmake \
          git \
